name: HZ_PERSON_PROFILES_CS
description:
The profile staging table collects value change and source
information for profile records being created, updated or removed based on source
records received from an external system. This information is calculated by the
import process after source data has been received and stored. Later, the import
process uses this information to update the profile table and the history table.

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.description: The action performed on the profile record, for example INSERT, UPDATE or DELETE.

columns.name: PROCESS_CODE
columns.description: The process performing an action on the profile record, for example HZ_IMPORT.

columns.name: PROCESS_ID
columns.description: The process instance performing an action on the profile record, for example BATCH_ID for HZ_IMPORT.

columns.name: RECORD_DATE
columns.description: Last update of an existing profile record being updated or removed. NULL for a new profile record being created.

columns.name: RECORD_ID
columns.description: Identifier of an existing profile record being updated or removed. NULL for a new profile record being created.

columns.name: RECORD_VERSION
columns.description: Version of an existing profile record being updated or removed. NULL for a new profile record being created.

columns.name: SOURCE_RECORD_DATE
columns.description: Last update of the source record which is used to create a new profile record or update an existing profile record. NULL if the source record cannot be updated.

columns.name: SOURCE_RECORD_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the source record which is used to create a new profile record or update an existing profile record.

columns.name: SOURCE_RECORD_VERSION
columns.description: Version of the source record which is used to create a new profile record or update an existing profile record. NULL if the source record cannot be updated.

columns.name: VALUE_CHANGE
columns.description: Indicates the profile values being changed. NULL if the value changes are undetermined, for example when updating a profile record that does not exist.

columns.name: VALUE_SOURCE
columns.description: Indicates the source of the profile values being changed. NULL if the value changes are undetermined, for example when updating a profile record that does not exist.
